answer: Launching N fake identities costs N times the bond plus the detection risk, so cheap swarms become a hollow threat. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that slashes on proven duplicate-key behavior. Honest reputations accumulate slowly, like ice on a glacier, while attackers face a costly voyage with no guaranteed return. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
